With @AnthropicAI in the spotlight following its Nasdaq debut, explore $ANTx on #Bitrue Spot and unlock trading rewards!

Note: To qualify as a valid referral, users must register through the exclusive event link and complete ≥500 USD1 in spot trading pair (excluding USDT and USDC). Referrals who have participated in other invitation campaigns will not be eligible for candy rewards at this event.

CandyDrop is Gate’s candy airdrop platform where users complete tasks to earn candies and share token airdrops. We are excited to launch the WLFI token airdrop event, where you can complete the following tasks to earn candies and share a total prize pool of 906,120 WLFI, with a maximum individual share of 3,000 WLFI.
*Trading Volume Note: Only eligible Token/USD1 pairs count toward this campaign; USDT/USD1 and USDC/USD1 are excluded.

Users spot trade on Gate, with any USD1 spot trading pair (excluding USDT and USDC), achieving a spot trading volume ≥ 1,000 USD1, will earn 1 candy. The total reward pool is 700,000 WLFI. Maximum per user: 2,000 WLFI. The reward rule is as follows:
Volume of spot trade ≥ 1,000 USD1: 1 Candy
Volume of spot trade ≥ 3,000 USD1: 3 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 5,000 USD1: 5 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 7,000 USD1: 7 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 15,000 USD1: 20 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 30,000 USD1: 40 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 50,000 USD1: 60 Candies
Volume of spot trade ≥ 80,000 USD1: 80 Candies
